candidates.statement: Postgres save_order spans ~2s and fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size=5 and idle=0, so checkout requests to order time out and the gateway returns 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or saturation counters; pool idle=0 is inferred from traces only.

report.explanation: Traces show postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s with pool size 5 and idle 0, propagating to order ReadTimeout and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout. Redis and payment calls succeed, so pool exhaustion at postgres is the bounded candidate; postgres-side metrics are still needed to confirm saturation.
